provisions.title: Definition
provisions.body: Authenticity rules are meant to be followed by all competitors attending Buhurt International tournaments, no matter the category. If a competitor shows up with an armor, shield or weapon that does not comply with the Authenticity rules, he/she risks a penalty.

provisions.title: Infraction Classification
provisions.body: During Authenticity Check, Authenticity officers will evaluate the entire equipment of competitors before the start of the tournament. Any violation of the Authenticity rules will result in an infraction. Infractions can be classified under 3 different levels:

provisions.title: Minor infraction
provisions.body: It is a small detail not easy to see, and it does not affect the coherence of the whole armor (small traces of rust, hammering marks, little datation difference between 2 parts etc.).

provisions.title: Moderate Infraction
provisions.body: It is something forbidden by the Authenticity rules (i.e badly designed helmet, over numerous eye bars etc.). Not respecting the rules can't be accepted, thus it is not severe enough to prevent the fighter from entering the list.

provisions.title: Major infraction
provisions.body: Fantasy armor or totally inaccurate equipment, that prevent the fighter from entering the list and damage the image of the sport, the teams and Buhurt International.

provisions.title: Application of the Rules
provisions.body:
A violation of the authenticity rules will result in a green card. Depending on the rank of tournament, infraction will be applied differently.

A green card combined with a yellow card will result in a red card and the competitor will be disqualified from the tournament.

A competitor can receive only 1 green card per tournament, no matter how many infractions they have.

provisions.title: Source
provisions.body:
No authenticity check required.
Authenticity members on site will be able to give advice and guidance.

provisions.title: Classic
provisions.body:
Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament.
A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respect the following cumulative criterias:

● Have no more than 3 minors infraction (if they have 4 or more, they will receive a green card).
● Have no more than 1 moderate infraction (if they have 2 or more, they will receive a green card.
● Have no major infraction.

provisions.title: Regional
provisions.body:
Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament.

A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respect the following cumulative criterias.
● Have no more than 2 minors infraction, if you have 3 or more, then they will receive a green card.
● Have no moderate infraction. If they have 1 or more, they will receive a green card.
● Have no major infraction.

provisions.title: Conference
provisions.body:
Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament.

A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respect the following cumulative criterias.
● Have no more than 1 minor infraction, if you have 2 or more, then they will receive a green card.
● Have no moderate infraction.
● Have no major infraction.

Note: as an exceptional measure, for season 2025, tournaments of Conference level will be considered as Regional regarding Authenticity rules. It means a competitor with 1 moderate infraction will be allowed to fight, but will receive a green card.
